rules.name: RIVER'S DOMAIN
rules.text: Your [Presence] in Wetlands counts as [Sacred Site] .
rules.turn:
spirit:special S rivers-domain, presence-of S P, at P L, terrain-for power L wetland
  / sacred-site S L
rules.evidence: ss-report river l2 (a single Presence p1 in wetland l2 is a Sacred Site); the lone Presence in mountain l3 is not
rules.notes: One acc row added to the base sacred-site view. Reading terrain through terrain-for power means an Ocean made a Coastal Wetland by Ocean's Hungry Grasp would also count -- an interaction neither rule mentions, which falls out of routing every terrain read through the view. Only works because the base computes sacred-site as a view (not inline `presence-count S L N, ge N 2` in each consumer).
